title: Trajectories of Change: KLD, Co-Citation, and Semantic-Density Metrics for Publication Trajectories
description: Trajectories of Change is a research package for comparing author- and field-level publication trajectories using Own- and Referenced-Vocabulary KLD, outgoing Citation-Identity KLD, and standardized semantic-density metrics on publication/reference parquet datasets. It provides a Python API, CLI, optional plotting helpers, deterministic synthetic oracle data, and a canonical two-Parquet data contract with optional provenance sidecars.
